assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and palpitations in the setting of known sick sinus syndrome and paroxysmal atrial fibrillation.
Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias and to guide further management of rate control and anticoagulation therapy.
The CPT code for the mobile cardiac telemetry is 93229.
The diagnosis code I49.5 is associated with the patient's conditions.
